strongestPassages: No listening rank. Note-level choices, not titles: leadsheet bars 1–4 and the Eb/A/G colour at 9 and 51; C’s wrong-world dyads suggested the Eb/A answer under bars 6–8; G’s delayed echo suggested bars 52–53; H’s Eb/A suggested the A that disturbs bar 45. A’s octave doubling, B’s cell cycle, D’s notes above fret 15, E’s constant motion, and F’s rotating pool were not copied.
Performance Edition V1.1 is the checked score. The composed peak is the prepared G6 at bar 34. E-V3.0 is the E source. Its internal movement title still says V2.0. That file was not edited.
blueprint.harmonicJourney: The line stays near C, Eb, and A. Harmony leaves the printed Cm6/Abmaj7 chain. Eb/A is the mirror axis under G. Bar 25 is a brief A major opposite. G is the common tone into the bar 34 peak and the Eb hold. The final bar is C and A; F is implied, not played.
blueprint.contrapuntalOpportunities: A second voice answers at bars 6–8, 19, 23, and 52–53. Elsewhere the guitar is one line or a dyad. Guitar octave-change is -1. Written pitch is not sounding pitch.
blueprint.dramaticClimax: Bars 29–36. The opening cell returns, the intervals widen, and written G6 is the tall note at f. Nobody has heard it. The printed f on the leadsheet was not itself a climax.
blueprint.thematicReturn: Bar 51 restates the colour. Bars 46–50 rebuild the opening cell out of order. Bars 64–65, the one refinement, compress M2 (F–Eb, then G–F) before the low A and the final C/A.

mci.innovation: Eb/A answers the descent. The climb to G6 is new. The eighth-note lift falls at bar 36. The Eb hold keeps G and drops D. M2 returns only as two short bars in the afterglow. This is not the Impossible Metaphysics seven-stage plan.
